title: Posting jobs is free
lead: While the platform is growing, posting jobs and accessing applications cost nothing. The only condition: the job lists a salary range and passes manual moderation.

publish.title: Posting
publish.text: Unlimited jobs. Moderation usually takes one business day.

applications.title: Applications
applications.text: Resumes, GitHub profiles and cover letters in your dashboard. Email notifications.

next.title: What's next
next.text: Paid plans will come later and will only cover promotion. Basic posting stays free for those who joined early.
